651b09c51184f702: Plan is the EFFECTIVE plan: active/trialing/past_due keep their plan_code; canceled keeps it only while cancel_at_period_end and ends_at is in the future; incomplete/unpaid/expired fall back to free. Users with no subscription row are free.
1185c2ca31243b85: Churned = a non-free plan_code on file whose effective plan has fallen back to free.
b1eaca6fb7f13800: Distinct lesson counts come from user_lesson_progress, never from learning_events: a repeated completion writes a fresh event (and a fresh XP transaction), so the event log double-counts.
cdb7aaef30d24bc8: Active = completed at least one lesson or submitted at least one quiz on that day. The platform records no 'app opened' event and session rows are deleted on logout, so a user who browses without learning is not counted. This is learning-activity, not visit activity.
5d96dbf3cffb17b1: All analytics buckets are UTC. Note daily_usage.usage_date is derived from the user's IANA timezone while user_streaks uses UTC, so daily rollups from those tables do not align exactly.
04038d22c3c08f74: Each stage counts users who performed that action in the range, not a strict subset of the stage above. A user can take a quiz without completing a lesson, so conversion is a ratio of two populations, not a true funnel subset.
37b35249b0d2fb14: lesson_started began being recorded when this analytics module shipped. Any range that starts before that date will undercount starts and overstate the first drop-off.
23f2b184bcdbfe9d: Module completion is a PROXY: user_module_progress.lesson_completed mirrors the module's lesson completion. The real module-completion rule is deliberately deferred (DEC-022), and module progress is therefore binary 0 or 100.
42e4b8eaef300ffe: quiz_attempts.status is only ever 'in_progress' or 'completed'. The CHECK constraint permits 'abandoned' but no code path writes it, so an abandoned attempt is indistinguishable from an in-progress one.
5a1e3788450a111c: Time-to-complete is measured from the first lesson_started of the day the lesson was first opened to the completion timestamp. It includes idle time between sessions.
1e5d1c5cb6eccd25: users_completed / users_started (distinct users in range), clamped to 100. lesson_started began being recorded when this module shipped, while completions have been recorded since launch — so on older content users_completed can exceed users_started and the raw counts should be read alongside the rate.
cc3438257bfc3237: Derived from quiz_answers.is_correct joined through question_learning_objectives and question_knowledge_items. A question mapped to N objectives contributes to all N, so objective attempt totals can exceed the number of questions answered.
2ba1a772de7d9d9f: Objectives/questions with fewer than {{minSample}} answers in range are excluded. Raise min_sample to suppress small-sample noise.
dede7f1b1ffe8c66: quiz_attempts.score is a 0-100 percentage; quizzes.passing_score is a 0-1 fraction.
9efc1f700d4c5cd9: Votes are upvote-only — a row exists while a user's upvote stands. There is no downvote.
dc56c9cfdd61f3a5: Reports are unique per (reporter, target), so re-reporting the same target does not create a second row.
1371588de00f50af: XP totals are awarded amounts from xp_transactions. A repeated lesson completion writes a fresh event and a fresh +50 transaction, so XP is inflatable by client retries and should not be read as 'XP earned once'.
5bf89b62acebfbdb: Streak day boundaries are hardcoded UTC and independent of the user's timezone. module_completed is listed as streak-qualifying but is emitted by no code path, so only lesson_completed and quiz_completed move a streak.
9343a014aec53336: streak_rows counts rows in user_streaks, which are created lazily on any gamification read — it is NOT an engagement signal.
44221fe4251d7bfd: No achievement definitions exist in this database, so nothing can unlock. Definitions are seeded at application startup; if this is zero the seed did not run.
82a5f501128926bc: There is no trial_started_at column. `trials` counts subscriptions currently in the 'trialing' status whose current period began in range — it is not a count of trials started, and a trial that ended inside the range is not counted.
9437f589311dfbc4: Counted from subscriptions.canceled_at. 'expired', 'incomplete' and 'unpaid' are valid statuses but no code path writes 'expired'.
3eda0876b9080eaf: by_plan reads subscriptions.plan_code (current state). Effective-plan resolution is exposed separately under effective_plans.
e9cd0dc3407bd7b1: users.country is written through isIsoCountryCode() on the signup and profile paths, so stored values are well-formed ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes. It IS nullable and not required at signup, so coverage is reported above and percentages are of users WITH a country.
160b43bb62027d01: Country is a profile attribute, not a connection property — it reflects what the user declared, not where they connected from.
bada24ee7acae1a6: No monetary amount is stored anywhere in Postgres. stripe_billing holds only Stripe identifiers and stripe_events stores no payload, so MRR/ARR/revenue must be read from the Stripe dashboard or API.
cda15cc99c3c0ad7: subscriptions holds current state only (one row per user, overwritten in place) and no plan-change history is recorded, so upgrades and downgrades are not derivable.
